decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY covering one visible ticket per primary mint, random no-referral allocations, the secondary-sale exclusion, and the affected display contexts.
Reconciling commission and ticket totals against primary mints does not change which successfully minted NFTs must appear in the dashboard inventory.
The source changes commission and ticket accounting, not the displayed referral count.
The source concerns aggregate reward accounting in dashboard and leaderboard contexts and does not change NFT metadata fields or their accuracy rules.
Commission and ticket totals are distinct from public referral-count statistics, whose required behavior remains unchanged.
Reward-count reconciliation has no necessary effect on NFT image or media rendering.
The source does not change the next-draw label or the sales-remaining countdown measure.

The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY establishing one Small Block ticket for every primary mint and excluding secondary-market sales; this already encompasses randomly allocated no-referral tickets.
The source changes commission and ticket count reconciliation, not the displayed prize-pool balance.
Mint totals serve as the reconciliation baseline in the source but the rule for counting successfully completed mints is not changed.
The FAQ already explains referred and no-referral reward allocation, and the source does not explicitly require a copy change.
The source does not change the $15 primary-mint split or allocation amounts; the existing state already assigns a $5 affiliate commission per primary mint.
